notes: Two independent branches (after «ح»), each naming its own transmitters; no common tail is written
«وقال مسدد عن ابن عباس» : Musaddad's version has Ibn Abbas directly: a variant, not a route
The wording variants (النقير والمقير, الإيمان بالله ثم فسرها) and the editor's gloss («أبو جمرة نصر بن عمران») are left out
